findings.title: Hero hierarchy and project visibility
reproduction_steps: Inspect first-screen hierarchy and project previews.
findings.observed: At1363×936, proof images are small within three equal columns; the broad school promise is followed by neural-only copy and multiple competing entry actions.
findings.expected: Make the school scope understandable and expose one clear primary action with legible proof.
findings.expectation_authority: User-requested school audit and polish; task invariant: discoverable choices, truthful feedback and reachable native controls.
findings.causal_gap: Behavior and impact after remediation require exact-head retest; no conversion analytics supplied.
competing_explanations: Neural specialization is an intentional priority; keep it as the initial course set.
Larger images are a design preference until user comprehension is measured.
findings.impact_summary: Potential friction is bounded to this journey; no abandonment, revenue or conversion magnitude measured.
findings.recommendation_direction: Keep navy/lime identity; use one leading proof image with two supporting examples; relocate neural quick-start into its catalog context; broaden hero copy without removing the eight-course entrance.
acceptance_criteria: All23 programs and8 neural routes remain usable.
Three genuine project previews remain visible and open their attributed lightboxes.
Review matched1440/390/320 screenshots; no cropped labels or horizontal overflow.

findings.title: Global save can omit an unfinished vacancy draft
reproduction_steps: Enter synthetic title Учебная проверка сохранения.
Click Сохранить на этом устройстве and observe success.
findings.observed: The global save reports success after a title is typed in vacancyForm; after reload, that title is empty.
findings.expected: A successful save must not imply unfinished form input was preserved; either preserve it or explain how to complete/discard it.
findings.expectation_authority: User-requested school audit and polish; task invariant: discoverable choices, truthful feedback and reachable native controls.
findings.causal_gap: Behavior and impact after remediation require exact-head retest; no conversion analytics supplied.
competing_explanations: Separate local add/save may be intentional, but the global success message is ambiguous.
Browser storage failure could also lose data; baseline source narrows the draft-omission mechanism.
findings.impact_summary: Potential friction is bounded to this journey; no abandonment, revenue or conversion magnitude measured.
findings.recommendation_direction: Block global save/export while a vacancy draft is dirty, focus the local action, and provide explicit clear/cancel recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Unfinished new or edited vacancy blocks misleading global saved/export feedback.
Completing or clearing the draft unblocks save/export.
Committed data survives reload; invalid draft does not overwrite a committed record.
